parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=6 from small-batch config: 1.1024 -> 1.0719. Next: combine DEPTH=6 with agent-3’s stabilizing low-LR setup (MATRIX_LR=0.06, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1), keeping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=65536. This tests if small-batch plus stability can beat agent-6’s depth-6 default.
